why: One method per argument shape through which a disposable local can reach a callee, with the conversion edge on the way. Each is classified against the frozen taxonomy; `a2_1_observed` records what the corrected A2.1 extractor (A') emitted for it, measured, not assumed, so the A2.2 steps move a named row, never a number.
observed_at_note: A' = corrected A2.1 treatment (PR #363), landed via main@23e3203; the extractor is byte-identical between A' and that merge. The superseded A (dce26ed) is not a measurement point.
a2_2_1_note: Measured with the A2.2-1 extractor (the IOperation value-flow walker) from the tree this file is committed in, before the commit: the SHA that carries this file is the SHA it was measured at. A2.2-1 promises exactly the transparent and may-value rows move to sidecar_call; every other row must read as it did at A'. A2.2-1a added the CheckedRef and Boxing rows, measured at both points.
a2_2_2_note: Measured with the A2.2-2 extractor (constructor calls as call-like sites) from the tree this file is committed in. A2.2-2 promises exactly the object_creation row(s) move to sidecar_call; every other row, delegate_invocation included, must read as it did after A2.2-1.
a2_2_2b_note: Measured with the A2.2-2b extractor (delegate invocation as a call-like site) from the tree this file is committed in. A2.2-2b promises exactly the delegate_invocation row that HAS a record moves to sidecar_call; the local-handle delegate row stays no_record (orphan carrier), every other row reads as after A2.2-2. Every historical column of a row added later was measured with that step's extractor, rebuilt at its commit, never assumed.
a2_2_3p_note: Measured with the A2.2-3P extractor (the guarded_functions[] orphan carrier) from the tree this file is committed in. A2.2-3P promises exactly the rows that read no_record after A2.2-2b AND have a relevant call or an eligible guard move to an orphan_* reading; a no_record row whose occurrence is a named exclusion stays no_record (no fact exists to carry); every row with a record reads as after A2.2-2b.

observed_vocabulary.sidecar_call: a function record with a guarded_facts call fact for the probe call, all captured calls being invocation expressions (no call_kind)
observed_vocabulary.sidecar_call:object_creation: captured, and the captured call is a constructor call (call_kind object_creation)
observed_vocabulary.sidecar_call:delegate_invocation: captured, and the captured call is a delegate invocation (call_kind delegate_invocation, callee/sig null)
observed_vocabulary.sidecar_call:mixed: captured calls of more than one kind in one probe method (none expected; a row reading this is a probe defect)
observed_vocabulary.orphan_call: no functions[] record, but a guarded_functions[] entry whose calls are invocation expressions (A2.2-3P)
observed_vocabulary.orphan_call:object_creation: no functions[] record; the orphan entry's call is a constructor call
observed_vocabulary.orphan_call:delegate_invocation: no functions[] record; the orphan entry's call is a delegate invocation
observed_vocabulary.orphan_call:mixed: orphan entry with calls of more than one kind (none expected)
observed_vocabulary.orphan_guards_only: no functions[] record; the orphan entry carries guards and no call
observed_vocabulary.record_without_call_fact: a function record exists but carries no call fact for the probe call
observed_vocabulary.no_record: the legacy pass emitted no function record at all (every candidate escaped)
observed_vocabulary.sidecar_call:constructor_initializer: captured, and the captured call is a constructor initializer (call_kind constructor_initializer, A2.2-4R5)
observed_vocabulary.orphan_call:constructor_initializer: no functions[] record; the orphan entry's call is a constructor initializer (an empty forwarding body lowers to nothing)

PlainSame.note: identity binding to a NON-consuming callee: the legacy pass reads the pass as an escape, no tracked local remains, no record at all; the orphan carrier's case (§10.6.6), and a direct flow

CheckedRef.note: explicit reference conversion on a Base-typed handle: the same reference or no call at all (the cast throws); never an alternate value, unlike `as`

DelegateCall.note: a local handle handed to a delegate is an escape for the legacy pass: no record at any step; the orphan carrier's case (§10.6.6)

DelegateCallOwned.note: owned parameter into a delegate invocation: the record exists, the target is unknown by construction (callee/sig null, first_party false), Invoke's declared ordinal 0 binds

Nested.note: Wrap(r) itself is direct and is owed its own call fact; Use receives call_result

Closure.note: the inner Use(r) belongs to the lambda body, which has no record of its own (known gap)

UserConversion.note: syntactically a bare identifier; only the semantic model shows the hidden op_Implicit

ExplicitUserConversion.note: syntactically a cast; the user-defined operator sits inside the cast expression, and (XBox)r already has type XBox at the call

Boxing.note: an owned disposable STRUCT parameter passed to object: the callee receives a boxed copy, not the handle; owned so the record exists regardless of legacy escape admission

PredicateResult.note: the predicate's bool is the argument; nothing of the handle flows (A2.2-4R4 ruling)

InterpolationHole.note: the built string is the argument (A2.2-4R4 ruling)

IndexerArgument.note: the handle is an argument of the indexer accessor's call, a call site the frozen vocabulary deliberately leaves out (A2.2-4R4 ruling); the legacy escape rule reads the index position as an argument, so every candidate escapes and no record exists

CtorInit.note: an owned constructor parameter forwarded through `: base(r, true)`: the target constructor's declared ordinal 0 binds (A2.2-4R5); the row is the constructor `Probe.CtorInit..ctor` of the nested class

a2_2_4_oracle_note: The completeness oracle's live reading of each row (A2.2-4): the verdict of the row's handle occurrence, `captured:<site kind>[+enclosing exclusions]` or `excluded:<named exclusion>`. Recorded by scripts/p037_completeness_oracle.py record and held equal by check; the oracle is checked against the class, never the other way round.
a2_2_4r4_note: Three rows added by the A2.2-4R4 ruling (PredicateResult, InterpolationHole, IndexerArgument). Their historical columns were measured with the extractor rebuilt at each step's commit (A' 5a0de070, A2.2-1 268bbd4, A2.2-2 376f2e6, A2.2-2b 7de7a6f, A2.2-3P 80cd9aa), never assumed: the first two read record_without_call_fact at every step (the handle never escapes, the method is admitted, no call fact), the third no_record (the index position is an argument to the legacy escape rule, every candidate escapes, nothing to carry).
a2_2_4r5_note: Measured with the A2.2-4R5 extractor (constructor initializers as call-like sites) from the tree this file is committed in. R5 promises exactly the constructor_initializer row moves, to orphan_call:constructor_initializer (its forwarding body is empty, so the legacy pass admits no record and the orphan carrier holds the fact); every other row reads as after A2.2-3P. The CtorInit row's historical columns were measured with the extractor rebuilt at each step's commit (A' 5a0de070, A2.2-1 268bbd4, A2.2-2 376f2e6, A2.2-2b 7de7a6f, A2.2-3P 80cd9aa): no_record at every step, because the initializer was never visited and an empty body carries nothing.
a2_2_4r6_note: Measured with the A2.2-4R6 extractor (the guarded-only member enumeration feeding the orphan carrier) from the tree this file is committed in. R6 promises no probe ROW moves (every row is a block-bodied static method of a class, or the CtorInit constructor, all inside the legacy enumeration); what moves is a helper: Box.op_Implicit, an expression-bodied conversion operator whose owned parameter flows into `new Box(m)`, now carries its object_creation fact as an orphan, and the completeness oracle reads the whole probe RED-free.
